WITH fee_order_user AS (
  SELECT f.orderslink, u.acctscope, f.feerate
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
),
pair_averages AS (
  SELECT orderslink, acctscope, AVG(feerate) as avg_feerate
  FROM fee_order_user
  GROUP BY orderslink, acctscope
),
mean_of_averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) as mean_rate
  FROM pair_averages
),
filtered_pairs AS (
  SELECT pa.orderslink, pa.acctscope, pa.avg_feerate, pa.avg_feerate - ma.mean_rate as excess
  FROM pair_averages pa
  CROSS JOIN mean_of_averages ma
  WHERE pa.avg_feerate > ma.mean_rate
),
ranked_pairs AS (
  SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC) as rank
  FROM filtered_pairs
)
SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, rank
FROM ranked_pairs
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY acctscope, rank;
